description: This file defines coroutine support structures, classes, and macros for asynchronous programming within the ocudu namespace, including coroutine frames, handle types, suspenders, and suspension macros.

classes.name: base_coro_frame
classes.description: Base class for coroutine frames, managing suspension state, awaiter storage, and coroutine lifecycle.

classes.name: base_coro_frame<void>
classes.description: Specialization of base_coro_frame for void promise type, handling suspension and awaiter management.

classes.name: base_coro_frame<Promise>
classes.description: Extension of base_coro_frame<void> that includes promise object and coroutine state.

classes.name: coro_frame<FunT>
classes.description: Coroutine frame that stores the coroutine function object, manages its lifecycle, and supports resumption and destruction.

classes.name: coro_handle<Promise>
classes.description: Handle to a coroutine, allowing resumption, destruction, and promise access.

classes.name: coro_handle<>
classes.description: Specialization of coro_handle for void promise type.

classes.name: coro_handle<Promise>
classes.description: Handle to a coroutine with a specific promise type, supporting promise retrieval and frame management.

classes.name: noop_coroutine_promise
classes.description: A promise type for a coroutine that does nothing, used for no-op coroutines.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes the coroutine from its suspended state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the coroutine frame, deallocating resources.

methods.name: on_return
methods.description: Handles cleanup of local objects upon coroutine completion.

methods.name: get_impl
methods.description: Retrieves the coroutine function object from storage.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the coroutine, transitioning it to a cancelled state.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Accesses the promise object associated with the coroutine.

methods.name: from_promise
methods.description: Creates a coroutine handle from a promise pointer.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Checks if the coroutine has completed execution.

methods.name: get_return_object
methods.description: Returns the coroutine's return object or future.
